entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait for the next available agent.
Hello? I... I need to return something. I hope I can.
Thank you for calling VeloFit. My name is Alex. I can certainly help you with that. Can I start with your name and order number?

It's Sarah Miller, order number is VF78901. I just feel awful about this. I've been a loyal customer for years, and I really saved up for this helmet. With the holidays, I really needed this money back if it wasn't perfect.

I understand completely, Sarah, and we certainly appreciate your loyalty. I have your order right here for the Pro-Ride Helmet. To make sure I understand correctly, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?

It's a preference thing. The color... it just wasn't what I expected from the pictures online. It doesn't match my jersey at all. The box is unopened, I haven't even taken it out. I was so disappointed when I saw it.

I see, so the color wasn't a match. That can definitely be frustrating when you're trying to coordinate your gear. Let me just pull up our return policy and check the eligibility for you. I see the order was delivered 15 days ago.
Okay, one moment... Yes, it looks like you're perfectly fine. Our policy allows for returns on items like this within 90 days of delivery, so you are well within that window.
Oh, really? So I can send it back for a full refund? Are you sure?

Absolutely. It's crucial that you're happy with your equipment, especially something as important for safety as a helmet. I've just processed the return authorization for you. You'll get an email shortly with a prepaid shipping label.
That's such a relief! Thank you so much, Alex. You have no idea how much this helps me right now.
You're very welcome, Sarah. We're happy to help. Once we receive the unopened box, we'll issue the full refund to your original payment method. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you again!
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
